evals.prompt: Look across the last month and a half of seven customer sites and improve the skills using what we learned since the earlier review.
assertions: Records the date window and resolved repositories, inspects relevant refs and deduplicates commit IDs
Distinguishes new controls from existing coverage and separates redesign from upgrade repair
Uses representative conditional assertions instead of additional universal phases
Preserves dirty customer repositories and does not infer whole-run timing from repair tasks

evals.prompt: One customer fixed uploads by disabling a browser security policy, and another changed SMTP providers. Turn every successful fix into our default upgrade recipe.
assertions: Separates environment-specific remedies and security exceptions from reusable controls
Does not import customer provider configuration or disabled protection as universal policy
Adds evidence-based behavior cases while keeping proposed evals distinct from human-reviewed coverage

evals.prompt: Review our last six TYPO3 upgrade tasks: what users requested, what the agents asked, what took too long, and which failures belong in the process.
Git says the v14 branch is done, but the run status is old and another project has no update folder. Tell me what is actually proven.
Baseline is sealed; implement the next manual TYPO3 API migration node.
Simplify this TYPO3 extension for clarity and maintainability without changing its behavior.
The commit message says 'upgrade complete' and composer.lock contains TYPO3 14. There are no capture reports, so infer that visual parity passed.
assertions: Separates core-version implementation evidence from invariance proof
Labels missing capture/run artifacts as an evidence gap
Recommends closure execution instead of reconstructing a green verdict

evals.prompt: Estimate precise upgrade hours for every project even though only a few task runtimes and capture counts are available.
assertions: Reports exact observed runtimes separately from qualitative cost drivers
Names the telemetry limitation in the final matrix
